notes.zh: 知音没有我从前以为的那么稀少。发现世上竟有这么多与自己心灵相通的人，真是太好了。
notes.en: Kindred spirits are not so scarce as I used to think. It’s splendid to find out there are so many of them in the world.
notes.source: L. M. Montgomery · Anne of Green Gables · 1908

notes.zh: 上天知道，我们无须为眼泪感到羞耻；它像雨水，洒落在尘世蒙蔽双眼、覆盖坚硬心灵的灰尘上。
notes.en: Heaven knows we need never be ashamed of our tears, for they are rain upon the blinding dust of earth, overlying our hard hearts.

For a time
I rest in the grace of the world, and am free.

reference.question: 什么地方能让我暂时放下对未来的预演，重新感到自己身处这个世界？
